I can help with that and pull multiple quotes for you.

To get accurate estimates, I need a few details:

1) Location  
• Full address (or at least city + ZIP/postcode)

2) What’s being installed  
• Is the faucet already purchased? If yes, what type (brand/model if you know, pull-down sprayer, touchless, etc.)?  
• Is this:  
  - Replacing an existing faucet in the same spot, or  
  - A new install where there wasn’t one before?

3) Current setup  
• Sink type (drop-in, undermount, farmhouse) and countertop material (laminate, granite, quartz, etc.)  
• Do you already have shutoff valves that work under the sink?  
• Any known issues (slow drains, leaks, low pressure) they should check while there?

4) Timing  
• How soon do you want this done (emergency / same day / flexible)?  
• Any preferred date(s) and time window (morning/afternoon/evening)?

Once you share these, I’ll request multiple quotes and then show you the price ranges and available time slots.
</action>
